verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official MCP server that lets chat or tool-calling clients drive the product, plus an Agent Quickstart for equipping agents to run the CLI or write SDK code, so natural-language operation works through an external AI client. The pricing page also lists a "Composer & Review Agent," but the evidence gives no detail showing it is a first-party natural-language command interface. The MCP evidence is mostly section headings. Missing for 10: a documented native natural-language interface inside the product, detail on what operations can be performed via natural language through MCP, and independent or hands-on corroboration of NL-driven use.
